testCase.name: [dev] S02 Nursing Home card on Today's Visits and on All Residents: no diagnosis, tap opens that resident's Pre-Round view, the Today toggle does not navigate

descriptionHtml:
Bug B28 · P2 · known

Nursing Home cards show the diagnosis and Nursing Home search matches on diagnosis (the spec says neither)

Tickets: TFA-92581 AC3 ready for qa; TFA-92579 AC 3 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92579): AC 3 of TFA-92579 says the diagnosis shows on Hospital cards only, so TC-01/S02 and the Nursing Home diagnosis cells of TC-01/S03 and S26 fail on it too.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-03/S07, TC-03/S09, TC-21/S16

Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S02 Nursing Home card on Today's Visits and on All Residents: no diagnosis, tap opens that resident's Pre-Round view, the Today toggle does not navigate

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Each patient renders as a card on the home screen showing the patient's first and last name and room (Nursing Home: unit/room). (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 3)
  • U2 The card shows the chief diagnosis on Hospital cards only; a Nursing Home card shows no diagnosis. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 3; UAT TC-03)
  • U4 The card shows the New Admission / Follow-up / Consult badge. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 3)
  • U7 Tapping a card opens that exact patient's Pre-Round view. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 5)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Standard fixture; the resident is on Today's Visits (manual adds join today's session) and stores the diagnosis 'Post-acute rehab after hip fracture'

When Switch to Nursing Home; on Today's Visits look at the card and tap it; go back; on All Residents look at the card and tap its body; go back; tap the card's Today toggle once, then once more to restore it

Then Both list views show the resident's card with the Follow-up badge and no diagnosis; each tap on the card body opens that resident's chart on Pre-Round; the Today toggle changes only the toggle and stays on the list

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: list checkpoints mustContain 'Open chart for <name>' and mustNotContain 'Post-acute rehab after hip fracture' (U2 per TC-03 / Q4; main shows it, so a Fail here is the real finding) and 'Pre-Round Notes'; chart checkpoints mustContain name, 'Pre-Round Notes', 'Admission status', mustNotContain 'Encounter Notes'; …

Where it ran: dev unit U22; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment dev · tickets TFA-92579 ready for qa; TFA-92581 ready for qa

On both Nursing Home lists (Today's Visits and All Residents), each resident card shows the stored diagnosis ('Post-acute rehab after hip fracture'), but Nursing Home cards must not show a diagnosis.

Evidence: dev U22 (ledger #22). Already in dev report §2 #4, cluster C1 (TFA-92581 AC 3, UAT TC-03). Opening the chart and the In Today toggle both pass. Same root cause as TC-03/S07, TC-03/S09 and part of TC-01/S03 and S26.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

UAT item: TC-01 Patient Chart Card · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-01/S02

Nursing Home card on Today's Visits and on All Residents: no diagnosis, tap opens that resident's Pre-Round view, the Today toggle does not navigate

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa)

Result: Fail from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (units/U22.verdict.json), unit U22 split by its parts' checkpoints. Agent: 81 turns, 275 s, $0.62.

Plan: unit U22 (#22, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Lists and cards, both contexts. Same legacy seed, same list screens. All four only look, open a chart, or flip In Today and flip it back. S13 (nothing entered is invented) runs first, before anything is opened. EFS S12 runs second: it turns In Today off and on and its checkpoint 4 checks the restore, so the parts after it start from a checked state. TC-01 S02 runs last, because its final tap ('tap it once more so it is back as it was') has no checkpoint after it. Runs together with TC-01/S13, EFS/S12, TC-01/S01.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #22, U22; checked: yes): Fail (S02 only, product) — S02: NH card shows the diagnosis on Today's Visits and All Residents — same root cause as U01 (cluster C1: NH card diagnosis, TFA-92581 AC 3 / UAT TC-03 + TC-01). S13, EFS S12 (empty Today's Visits message + how to add), S01 pass
